$comment: Job templates of the travel business type (jobs contract section 5). DRAFT: every customer-facing text is for a native reader to check before it goes live. Written for travel agents and tour operators. No price, discount, delivery promise, refund promise or guarantee anywhere; templates are for enquirers and consenting customers only; the researcher template never calls or messages prospects (the owner reaches out personally). The invented prospects are fictional.
